TECHNICAL.definition: Photograph lacks sharpness due to motion blur, missed optical focus, camera shake, or heavy ISO grain.
examples: Blurred hands and faces during food distribution

TECHNICAL.display_name: Dark, Overexposed, Harshly Backlit or Shadow-Heavy (RULE_09)
TECHNICAL.definition: Subjects are poorly lit due to underexposure, blown-out highlights, strong backlighting, or heavy facial shadows.
examples: Overexposed white volunteer shirts losing detail

COMPOSITION.definition: Volunteer is captured primarily from behind, blocking the interaction instead of using a front or side angle.
examples: Volunteer's back occupies foreground while handing food to beneficiary

COMPOSITION.display_name: Beneficiary Face Obstructed or Awkwardly Cropped (RULE_03)
COMPOSITION.definition: Beneficiary's face or expression is hidden behind objects/arms or sliced by the frame border.
examples: Beneficiary face blocked by volunteer's arm
Half of beneficiary head cropped out

COMPOSITION.definition: Tilted horizon (Dutch angle), extreme high/low perspective, or angle that fails to capture volunteer-beneficiary interaction.
examples: Severely tilted horizon line during outdoor distribution

COMPOSITION.definition: Background clutter, scattered packaging, litter, or unrelated objects taking attention away from the seva.
examples: Empty cardboard boxes and plastic wrappers scattered behind distribution table

EDITORIAL.definition: Beneficiaries or volunteers staring directly into the camera lens instead of engaging naturally in the activity.
examples: Volunteer and beneficiary pausing mid-handover to stare at camera

EDITORIAL.definition: Artificial, stiffly posed handover or group line-up lacking genuine candid compassion and interaction.
examples: Four volunteers holding a single packet together in a static pose

EDITORIAL.display_name: Actual Seva Activity Not Clearly Visible (RULE_06 & RULE_12)
EDITORIAL.definition: Cannot discern the seva being performed (e.g., food distribution, education support, healthcare, animal care).
examples: Volunteers standing idle without visible seva activity or beneficiaries

EDITORIAL.display_name: Lacks Spirit of Humanity and Compassion (RULE_16)
EDITORIAL.definition: Mechanical, detached, or cold interaction that fails to convey kindness, empathy, or human warmth.
examples: Volunteer handing item without looking at or engaging with the beneficiary

BRAND.display_name: Banner Folded, Crumpled, Tilted or Obscured (RULE_01)
BRAND.definition: NGO banner is present in the frame but has visible creases, folds, crumpling, sagging, or obstructed text.
examples: Wrinkled banner hanging crookedly behind food stall

BRAND.definition: Volunteer is not wearing white-on-white or a white top with jeans, or clothing appears untidy/stained.
examples: Volunteer wearing bright red graphic t-shirt during distribution

BRAND.definition: Portrays beneficiaries in a demeaning, pitiable, or distressing manner that violates their dignity.
examples: Unflattering close-up of distressed patient or beneficiary in vulnerable posture

SAFETY.display_name: Visible Medical Records, PII or Safeguarding Concern
SAFETY.definition: Visible patient medical charts, prescription details, personal ID documents, or unverified minor consent during healthcare/education seva.
examples: Readable patient diagnosis sheet on healthcare camp table

CONTEXT.display_name: Near-Duplicate Frame From Same Seva Burst
CONTEXT.definition: Part of a camera burst from the same seva moment where another frame has better expressions or angles.
examples: Sequential frame 2 of 5 from same food distribution interaction
